note: Widened transfer test of the A23 margin-mass certificate: the same corpora encoded with a registry of frozen encoders, then every ordered pair of (encoder, corpus) units is asked whether a threshold on M fitted on the source survives on the target. New file; no existing archive is modified.

meta.margin_definition: margin_i = s_i(y_i) - max_{c != y_i} s_i(c); M(eps) = mean(1[margin <= 2 eps])
meta.family_definition: image-side gap surgery x_lambda = normalize(i + lambda * ||d|| * d_hat) with d = mean(text/probe rows) - mean(image features), lambda in [-1.0, -0.5, -0.25, 0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0], plus one text-side configuration text1.0 (t - 1.0 * ||d|| * d_hat)

relative_eps_definitions.median_margin: eps_row = c * median_i(margin_i) of that configuration
relative_eps_definitions.sigma_relative: eps_row = c * sigma_D with sigma_D = 1 - mean_i max_{c != y_i} s_i(c)

meta.family_note: tools/_p1472 used seven lambdas on the control (no text-side row) and eight plus the text-side row on the adapted encoders; this script applies the union (eight lambdas plus text1.0 = nine configurations) to every unit uniformly, which is why the reproduction check compares only the rows the archives actually carry
meta.prompt_note: prompts follow the archived scripts ('a photo of a <class>' and 'a photo of a <sciName>'); tools/_p1472's adapted arm used 'a photo of <sciName>' instead, so its adapted rows differ from these by up to 0.01 in M while the archived adapted rows are reproduced instead

correlations.note: within_unit: Pearson r between each statistic and top-1 over the nine family configurations of one (encoder, corpus) unit; pooled: the same over all units' rows together

protocol.unit: (encoder, corpus); a unit's configurations are its nine surgery-family rows
protocol.statistic: the 13 keys in meta.statistic_keys (7 absolute eps, 3 median-margin-relative, 3 sigma-relative)
protocol.source_fit: threshold t on the statistic that maximises BA(stat <= t, top1 <= median(top1 over the unit's family)) on the source family; exact search over the observed source values (the archived code searched a 401-point linspace over the same range, a sub-grid of this search)
protocol.target_score: BA(stat <= t_source, top1 <= median(top1 over the target's family))
protocol.health_label_note: the archived label convention (_p1352/_p1370): a configuration whose top-1 is at or below its unit's median is 'unhealthy'; balanced accuracy is invariant to the naming and the archived transfer numbers are computed the same way
protocol.degenerate_rule: when either class is empty the fit is undefined and the entry carries target_BA = null with degenerate = true (the archived helper coerced the empty denominator to 1 and would report 0.5); the point estimates agree with the archive on every non-degenerate row
protocol.bootstrap: paired bootstrap over images: 2000 draws with replacement per unit; the source threshold is refitted on the resampled source family and the target BA recomputed on the resampled target family. When source and target share a corpus the same image indices are used on both sides (paired = true); across corpora the draws are independent (paired = false).
protocol.survives_rule: the 2.5th percentile of (target BA - chance) over the usable draws is > 0

summary.self_pairs_excluded_from_the_claim: a self-pair (same unit on both sides) fits and scores on the same nine configurations in-sample, so it is reported but never counted as a transfer; the claim is evaluated on the 260 cross-unit entries
summary.survivor_caveat: a survivor with few distinct values of the statistic across the nine target configurations (target_value_n_distinct) is a structural split of a small surgery family rather than a calibrated operating point; the family size is nine configurations per unit

conclusion.question: does a threshold on the margin-mass statistic M transfer from one (encoder, corpus) unit to another?
conclusion.headline: no entry beats chance by a margin that survives the paired bootstrap over images: of 260 scored cross-unit (pair, statistic) entries 7 are nominally above chance 0.50 and none of those keeps its 95 % bootstrap interval above chance (best nominal entry oceanclip__rare_species -> clip-vit-base-patch32__marine_optical on mass_0p01: target BA 1.000, delta CI95 [-0.150, 0.500]). The negative claim is therefore supported for all 25 ordered pairs over 5 encoder x corpus units (3 encoders, 3 corpora), i.e. it can be widened rather than weakened.
conclusion.claim: the no-transfer claim can be widened to every registered encoder x corpus pair

effect_on_a23_text.current_sentence_scope: the A23 text asserts, on the strength of the generic-CLIP control plus the two adapted encoders, that no threshold on M transfers across domains or encoders (best cross-domain balanced accuracy 0.50-0.55 against chance 0.50)
effect_on_a23_text.action: this run covers only 3 encoder(s) -- a partial selection recorded in meta.selection -- so the sentence can be widened only after the full grid is analysed; the no-transfer result does repeat on every pair analysed here (5 units, 25 ordered pairs, no bootstrap survivor)

probes.single_seed: the linear probe is fitted with one split seed (0) and one training seed; a different split can move a probe unit's top-1 and its family
probes.protocol: no-bias multinomial logistic regression on L2-normalized frozen features (a cosine classifier head), fitted on the CPU with full-batch Adam (lr 0.05, weight decay 1e-4, 400 epochs, torch.manual_seed(0)) on a stratified 70/30 split drawn with numpy.random.default_rng(0); the 30 % held-out split is the only part used for the reported top-1 and margins, so the probe is always out-of-sample

class_imbalance.note: top-1 is computed on the natural corpora with no class-balanced reweighting, so a unit's top-1 is dominated by its largest class

encoder_count.note: encoders are frozen and used exactly as published; none was fine-tuned here, so the comparison is between checkpoints, not between training recipes

family_size.note: the health label is a median split of nine top-1 values and a transferred BA over nine target values has a granularity of 1/4 to 1/5; a source fit near 1.0 on nine points is not evidence of a usable operating point (inherited from _p1472)

limits.statistic: M(eps) is the margin CDF evaluated at 2 eps, so it saturates as soon as 2 eps exceeds the bulk of the margin distribution; the median margin of these deep operating points is negative, which is why the fine grid starts at 0.001
limits.bootstrap_scope: the bootstrap resamples images within a corpus; it quantifies image-sampling uncertainty only, not encoder choice, prompt choice or the construction of the surgery family
limits.corpora: the marine and sonar trees are the raw data trees used by the archived control (7 classes, 343 and 1783 images, the eighth sonar class `tire` excluded by construction), not the manuscript's canonical protocols (6 concepts / 144 frames optical, 8 classes / 650 balanced sonar); the 67-class subset is the manuscript's marine reference domain
limits.artifact_scope: the local run of this script can cover fewer units than the cloud run; meta.selection and meta.complete_for_selection record exactly which units are inside this archive
list: single seed for the linear probe (split seed 0, training seed 0) and one architecture per encoder
class-imbalanced corpora: sonar floats 951/1783 images, marine 7-61 images per class; the 67-class subset is balanced at 24
encoder count: 7 registered, 3 selected, 3 analyzed; probe-free results are zero-shot and probe results are out-of-sample on 30 % of the corpus
nine configurations per unit make the health label a median split and the transfer BA coarse
the bootstrap covers image sampling only; encoder, prompt and surgery-family choices are not resampled
cross-corpus pairs cannot use the paired bootstrap (the image sets differ), so their intervals are unpaired
the marine and sonar corpora are raw data trees rather than the manuscript's canonical protocols
ascending/descending label convention: 'unhealthy' means top-1 at or below the median, as archived
